newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SMIT INTERN. STAKES TO BE SOLD IN JUNE.
newsitem.headline: SMIT INTERN. STAKES TO BE SOLD IN JUNE.

text.p: Shipping group Smit Internationale NV said on Monday the previously announced sale of 80 percent of its shares was seen taking place next month.
"Depending on market circumstances, the major shareholders are expected to offer their stakes to be sold in June," the company said in a statement.

Smit said in April that its two major shareholders, transport group Koninklijke Nedlloyd and unlisted investment firm Vigilanter, were planning to sell their stakes. The two now each hold a 40 percent interest in Smit.
Smit said Nedlloyd and Vigilanter had appointed investment banks Credit Suisse First Boston and MeesPierson for the sale of the shares.

Earlier this month, Smit posted a 1996 net profit of 98.5 million guilders, sharply up from 20.8 million in the previous year. The 1996 net included a 73.5 million one-off gain on the sale of its supply vessels fleet to Seacor Holding Inc of the U.S.
Smit said it expected further profit growth before extraordinary items in 1997.
